wga-2023.name: Writers Guild of America 2023 contract AI terms
wga-2023.outcome: AI can't write or rewrite literary material; studios must disclose AI-made materials
wga-2023.limits: Covers film and TV writers only; leaves training on writers' scripts unresolved, reserving only the right to object.
wga-2023.locator: Artificial Intelligence section: "AI can't write or rewrite literary material"

wga-2026.name: Writers Guild of America 2026 tentative agreement
wga-2026.outcome: Four-year tentative agreement announced in early April 2026, a few weeks before the May 1 contract expiration; expected to add rules including licensing for AI training
wga-2026.limits: Tentative deal that still required ratification by union members; ratification and final AI terms were not confirmed from an opened page.
wga-2026.locator: Published April 5, 2026: "four-year tentative agreement"; "still requires ratification by union members"

sag-aftra-2023.name: SAG-AFTRA 2023 TV and theatrical contract digital replica terms
sag-aftra-2023.outcome: Explicit signed or initialed consent required for digital replicas; pension and health contributions for independent replicas
sag-aftra-2023.limits: Law-firm summary, not the contract text; covers screen performers only; exemptions for commentary, parody and biographical works.

nber-genai-at-work.name: Generative AI at Work (Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond)
nber-genai-at-work.place: Customer support at one US software firm
nber-genai-at-work.outcome: 5,179 agents; 14% more issues resolved per hour on average, 34% for novice and low-skilled workers; AI assistance also increased employee retention
nber-genai-at-work.limits: One firm and one kind of job, agents mostly in the Philippines; the most experienced agents gained little.
nber-genai-at-work.locator: Abstract: "by 14% on average"; "a 34% improvement for novice and low-skilled workers"; "increases employee retention"

stanford-canaries.name: Canaries in the Coal Mine (Brynjolfsson, Chandar and Chen)
stanford-canaries.outcome: Employment of 22- to 25-year-olds in AI-exposed occupations 19% below where it would otherwise be
stanford-canaries.limits: Working paper revised August 12, 2026; one payroll provider's data; shows correlation with AI exposure, not proof of cause.
stanford-canaries.locator: "now stands 19% below where it would be"

ilo-exposure-2025.name: ILO and NASK refined global index of generative AI exposure
ilo-exposure-2025.outcome: One in four jobs potentially exposed; transformation, not replacement, most likely; clerical work most exposed
ilo-exposure-2025.limits: Measures potential exposure of tasks, not actual job losses; read through a UN News summary.
ilo-exposure-2025.locator: Calls the ILO the "UN labour agency"; "Transformation of jobs is the most likely impact of GenAI."

nyc-ll144.name: New York City Local Law 144 on automated hiring tools, and the State Comptroller's enforcement audit
nyc-ll144.outcome: Law passed in 2021 requires employers using automated hiring tools to get a yearly bias audit and notify candidates; enforcement began July 2023; the city found 1 compliance issue among 32 companies, state auditors found at least 17
nyc-ll144.limits: One city; the audit found enforcement weak, so the law alone has changed little so far.
nyc-ll144.locator: Audit covered enforcement from July 2023 through June 2025; "identified at least 17 instances of potential non-compliance under LL144"

elements-of-ai.name: Elements of AI free online course
elements-of-ai.outcome: Created by the University of Helsinki and Reaktor; goal of teaching 1% of Finns (about 54,000); nearly 90,000 people from 80 countries enrolled in about four months; 37% of students women and 21% over 45
elements-of-ai.limits: 2018 figures; enrollment is not completion, and an intro course is not job retraining.
elements-of-ai.locator: "nearly 90 000 people from 80 countries have enrolled"; female students (37 per cent), over 45 (21 per cent)

klarna-rehire.name: Klarna returns to human customer service
klarna-rehire.outcome: CEO said AI customer service gave lower quality; company began hiring human agents again
klarna-rehire.limits: One company's account through press coverage; the new roles are a flexible remote model, not necessarily the old jobs.
klarna-rehire.locator: "investing in the quality of human support is the way of the future for us"

eu-ai-act-work.name: European Union AI Act rules for AI at work
eu-ai-act-work.outcome: Employers must inform staff and representatives before using high-risk AI; workplace emotion recognition prohibited
eu-ai-act-work.limits: Informing is required, consulting is not; unions get no general veto over new AI systems.

taa-texas.name: Trade Adjustment Assistance (as described by the Texas Workforce Commission)
taa-texas.outcome: Federal program paying for retraining, income support and a wage supplement for workers 50 and older; expired July 1, 2022
taa-texas.limits: Covered only jobs lost to trade, never to technology; lapsed in 2022 and only previously certified workers are still served.

onet.name: O*NET OnLine
onet.outcome: Breaks occupations into over 19,000 task statements; marks growing occupations Bright Outlook
onet.limits: Task lists lag real jobs; says nothing about which tasks AI does well.
onet.locator: Bright Outlook: occupations "expected to grow rapidly in the next several years"; Job Duties search, 19,000 tasks

cfpb-emergency-fund.name: CFPB guide to building an emergency fund
cfpb-emergency-fund.limits: General guidance with no target amount; saving is hard on a tight income.
cfpb-emergency-fund.locator: "even a small amount can provide some financial security"

anthropic-economic-index.name: Anthropic Economic Index
anthropic-economic-index.limits: One AI company's data about its own product; the page's figures did not load when opened.
anthropic-economic-index.locator: Tagline: "Understanding AI's effects on the economy"; last updated Jun 26, 2026

skillsfuture-midcareer.name: SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) top-up
skillsfuture-midcareer.outcome: $4,000 course credit for citizens 40 and over, plus training allowance (from search summaries)
skillsfuture-midcareer.limits: Official pages did not render and the budget annex returned 404 in this run; figures from search results only.

aflcio-microsoft.name: AFL-CIO and Microsoft partnership on AI
aflcio-microsoft.outcome: Labor federation and tech company agree to share AI information, take worker input and a neutrality framework (from search summaries)
aflcio-microsoft.limits: Page fetch was rate-limited; no evidence found of results for workers.
